description: Create a project-level snapshot for either project status or ad hoc type. This is rate limited to one request per hour for each project and budget view, regardless of snapshot type.

initial.description: Whether this is the initial status for new snapshots

financial_period.description: The financial period the snapshot is assigned to. Present for project status snapshots that have a period assigned; null otherwise (including ad hoc snapshots).

group_name.description: Name of the group the financial period belongs to

status.description: Whether the financial period is currently open or closed

start_date.description: First day of the financial period

end_date.description: Last day of the financial period

links.description: Links to get data for this snapshot

detail_rows.description: URL to the Snapshot Detail Rows for this budget view snapshot

date_range_for_actuals.description:
Filters actuals data to a specific date range when generating the snapshot.
Provide exactly two dates in ISO 8601 format representing the start and end of the range.

only_actuals_with_dates.description:
When true, only actuals records with a date within date_range_for_actuals are included.
When false (default), actuals records with no date are also included alongside date-ranged results.

financial_period_id.description:
The ID of the Financial Period to associate with this snapshot.
Only available when the Financial Periods feature is enabled.
